name: IpGeolocationResponse
description:
The top-level response object for a single IP lookup. Where fields and nested
objects appear depends on your plan (free vs. paid) and the `include`, `fields`,
and `excludes` parameters. The `ip` field is always present.

ip.description:
The looked-up IP address. If a domain was queried, this is the resolved IP.
If no `ip` parameter was sent, this is the caller's public IP.

domain.description:
Present only when the `ip` query parameter contained a domain name. Mirrors
the domain value from the request.

hostname.description:
Reverse-DNS hostname for the IP. Returned only when one of the hostname
`include` options is used (`hostname`, `liveHostname`, or
`hostnameFallbackLive`). If no hostname can be resolved, this field contains
the IP address itself.

location.description: Geographic location data for the IP address.

country_name_official.description: Official country name as recognized by the UN.

state_prov.description: State, province, or top-level administrative region.

district.description: District, county, or second-level administrative division.

locality.description:
Locality or neighborhood. May be the same as `city`. Only present when
`include=geo_accuracy` or `include=*` is used.

accuracy_radius.description:
Estimated accuracy radius in kilometers around `latitude` and `longitude`.
Only present when `include=geo_accuracy` or `include=*` is used.

confidence.description:
Confidence level for the accuracy radius. Possible values: `high`, `medium`,
`low`. Only present when `include=geo_accuracy` or `include=*` is used.

dma_code.description:
Nielsen Designated Market Area code. Only populated for US-based IPs.
Present when `include=dma_code` or `include=*` is used. Empty string for
non-US IPs.

is_eu.description: Whether the country is a member of the European Union.

country_flag.description: URL to a 64x64 PNG of the country flag.

country_emoji.description: Unicode flag emoji for the country.

country_metadata.description: Telephone, TLD, and language information for the country.

languages.description: IETF language tags spoken in the country, ordered by prevalence.

network.description:
Network routing information for the IP. Included by default on paid plans.
Not available on the free plan.

connection_type.description:
Type of network connection for this IP. Known values: `DSL`, `Cable`,
`Fiber`, `Mobile`, `Wireless`, `Dial-Up/ISDN`, `Satellite`. Empty string
when the type cannot be determined.

route.description: BGP route prefix in CIDR notation.

is_anycast.description: Whether the IP is part of an anycast network.

currency.description: Local currency of the country where the IP is located.

asn.description:
Autonomous System Number details for the IP. Free plans receive `as_number`,
`organization`, and `country` only. Paid plans also receive `type`, `domain`,
`date_allocated`, and `rir`.

organization.description: Name of the organization that owns the ASN.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country where the ASN is registered.

type.description:
Organization type. Values: `ISP`, `HOSTING`, `BUSINESS`, `EDUCATION`,
`GOVERNMENT`. Paid plans only.

domain.description: Primary domain of the ASN holder. Paid plans only.

date_allocated.description:
Date when the ASN was allocated, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format (e.g.
`2024-12-13`). Paid plans only.

rir.description: Regional Internet Registry (RIR) that allocated the ASN. Possible values include `RIPE`, `ARIN`, `APNIC`, `LACNIC`, `AFRINIC`, etc.

company.description:
Company or organization operating the IP range. Included by default on paid
plans. Not available on the free plan.

type.description:
Company category. Documented values: `ISP`, `HOSTING`, `BUSINESS`,
`EDUCATION`, `GOVERNMENT`. All uppercase, consistent with `asn.type`.
May be an empty string when the company type cannot be determined.

security.description:
Threat intelligence and anonymization signals for the IP. Only returned when
`include=security` or `include=*` is used. Costs 2 additional credits.

threat_score.description:
Overall threat score from 0 (clean) to 100 (high risk). Aggregated from
all the individual signals below.

is_tor.description: Whether the IP is a known Tor exit node.

is_proxy.description: Whether the IP belongs to a known proxy service.

proxy_provider_names.description: Names of proxy providers associated with this IP, if any.

proxy_confidence_score.description:
Confidence that this IP is a proxy, from 0 to 100. Only meaningful when
`is_proxy` is `true`.

proxy_last_seen.description:
Date when this IP was last observed acting as a proxy, in `YYYY-MM-DD`
format. Empty string if never seen.

is_residential_proxy.description: Whether the IP is a known residential proxy.

is_vpn.description: Whether the IP belongs to a known VPN provider.

vpn_provider_names.description: Names of VPN providers associated with this IP, if any.

vpn_confidence_score.description:
Confidence that this IP is a VPN endpoint, from 0 to 100. Only meaningful
when `is_vpn` is `true`.

vpn_last_seen.description:
Date when this IP was last observed as a VPN endpoint, in `YYYY-MM-DD`
format. Empty string if never seen.

is_relay.description: Whether the IP is part of a known relay network (e.g. iCloud Private Relay).

relay_provider_name.description: Name of the relay provider, if any. Empty string if not a relay.

is_anonymous.description:
Whether the IP is associated with any anonymization method (VPN, proxy,
Tor, or relay).

is_known_attacker.description: Whether the IP has been flagged in known attacker or threat feeds.

is_bot.description: Whether the IP is associated with known bot activity.

is_spam.description: Whether the IP is listed in spam databases.

is_cloud_provider.description: Whether the IP belongs to a cloud hosting or data center provider.

cloud_provider_name.description: Name of the cloud provider, if applicable. Empty string otherwise.

abuse.description:
Abuse contact information for the network that owns this IP. Only returned when
`include=abuse` or `include=*` is used. Costs 1 additional credit.

route.description: BGP route prefix this abuse contact is responsible for, in CIDR notation.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the abuse contact. May be empty.

name.description: Name of the abuse contact person or team.

organization.description: Organization name of the abuse contact. May be empty.

kind.description: Contact type from registry data. Values include `group`, `individual`.

address.description: Postal address of the abuse contact. Returned as a plain comma-separated string.
address.example: Tele2 AB/Swedish IP Network, IP Registry, Torshamnsgatan 17 164 40 Kista SWEDEN

phone_numbers.description: Phone numbers for the abuse contact.

time_zone.description: Timezone information for the geographic location of the IP.

offset_with_dst.description:
Current UTC offset in hours, accounting for DST if active. Same as
`offset` when DST is not in effect.

current_time.description:
Current local time at the IP's location. Observed formats include
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss±ZZZZ` and `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.SSS±ZZZZ`.

current_time_unix.description: Current time as a Unix timestamp with millisecond precision.

current_tz_abbreviation.description: Abbreviation of the timezone currently in effect (may be standard or DST).

current_tz_full_name.description: Full name of the timezone currently in effect.

standard_tz_full_name.description: Full name of the standard (non-DST) timezone.

is_dst.description: Whether Daylight Saving Time is currently active.

dst_savings.description:
DST offset in hours applied on top of the standard offset when DST is
active. `0` means no DST shift (either DST is not active or does not exist).

dst_exists.description: Whether this timezone observes Daylight Saving Time at all.

dst_tz_abbreviation.description: Abbreviation of the DST timezone. Empty string if DST is not observed.

dst_tz_full_name.description: Full name of the DST timezone. Empty string if DST is not observed.

dst_start.description:
Start DST transition details. When `dst_exists` is `false`, this is
returned as an empty object with no properties.

oneOf.description:
Details about a DST transition (start or end). Only present when `dst_exists`
is `true`. When `dst_exists` is `false`, `dst_start` and `dst_end` are
returned as empty objects with no properties.

utc_time.description: UTC time of the transition, formatted as `YYYY-MM-DD TIME HH:mm`.

duration.description:
Clock shift direction and amount (e.g. `+1.00H` for spring forward,
`-1.00H` for fall back).

gap.description:
Whether this transition creates a gap in local time (clocks jump forward).
`true` for DST start, `false` for DST end.

date_time_after.description: Local time immediately after the transition.

date_time_before.description: Local time immediately before the transition.

overlap.description:
Whether this transition creates an overlap in local time (clocks fall back,
so the same local time occurs twice). `true` for DST end, `false` for DST
start.

dst_end.description:
End DST transition details. When `dst_exists` is `false`, this is
returned as an empty object with no properties.

oneOf.description:
Details about a DST transition (start or end). Only present when `dst_exists`
is `true`. When `dst_exists` is `false`, `dst_start` and `dst_end` are
returned as empty objects with no properties.

utc_time.description: UTC time of the transition, formatted as `YYYY-MM-DD TIME HH:mm`.

duration.description:
Clock shift direction and amount (e.g. `+1.00H` for spring forward,
`-1.00H` for fall back).

gap.description:
Whether this transition creates a gap in local time (clocks jump forward).
`true` for DST start, `false` for DST end.

date_time_after.description: Local time immediately after the transition.

date_time_before.description: Local time immediately before the transition.

overlap.description:
Whether this transition creates an overlap in local time (clocks fall back,
so the same local time occurs twice). `true` for DST end, `false` for DST
start.

user_agent.description:
Parsed User-Agent information. Only returned when `include=user_agent` or
`include=*` is used. The API parses the `User-Agent` header from the request.
For server-side usage, forward your visitor's User-Agent string in the header.

user_agent_string.description: The raw User-Agent string that was parsed.
user_agent_string.example: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/143.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/143.0.0.0

type.description:
Client type classification. Common values: `Browser`, `Robot`,
`Mobile Browser`, `Library`.

version.description: Full version string of the detected client.

version_major.description: Major version number of the detected client.

device.description: Device information extracted from the User-Agent string.

brand.description: Device manufacturer or brand. `Unknown` if not detectable.

cpu.description: CPU architecture if detectable (e.g. `Intel x86_64`, `ARM`). `Unknown` otherwise.

engine.description: Rendering engine information extracted from the User-Agent string.

type.description: Engine classification. Typically matches the client type.

version.description: Full version of the rendering engine.

version_major.description: Major version of the rendering engine.

operating_system.description: Operating system information extracted from the User-Agent string.

version.description: OS version. `??` when the version cannot be determined.

version_major.description: OS major version. `??` when the version cannot be determined.

build.description: OS build number. `??` when the build cannot be determined.
